requirements.quote: File must contain the following five separate lines in this order (each terminated by a newline):

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
exp = 'LANG=en_US.UTF-8
LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8
LC_TIME=de_DE.UTF-8
LC_NUMERIC=en_US.UTF-8
LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8
'
sys.exit(0 if open('/home/user/server_configs/locale_settings/locale.conf').read() == exp else 1)
PYEOF

requirements.quote: a) Spawn Job #1 in the background to copy timezone.txt to /home/user/.timezone.
b) Spawn Job #2 in the background to append the five locale variables (exactly as found in locale.conf) to /home/user/.bashrc *only if they are not already present*.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
L = open('/home/user/.bashrc').read().splitlines()
exp = ['LANG=en_US.UTF-8', 'LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8', 'LC_TIME=de_DE.UTF-8', 'LC_NUMERIC=en_US.UTF-8', 'LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8']
sys.exit(0 if all(sum(1 for l in L if l.strip() in (e, 'export ' + e)) == 1 for e in exp) else 1)
PYEOF

requirements.quote: c) Use a solitary wait command to hold until both background jobs finish.
d) Echo the single line “Timezone and locale applied.” to STDOUT.
